deviceLog.meaning: App Transport Security refused an insecure load

interpretation: On iOS 10 and later NSAllowsLocalNetworking presence overrides NSAllowsArbitraryLoads; this matches the device ATS rejection. IPA after signing has not been inspected.
fix: Remove all three overriding keys; verify generated app plist before packaging.
validation: 31 local verifier checks pass, and the actual 0.0.6 built Info.plist is rejected by the updated check. The new iOS build and device connection are not yet verified.
